messages:
ryan: noticed a spike in restore failures: 18 errors in the last hour, all AccessDenied from KMS during Unwrap.
maria: paste the log?
ryan: ```
2026-06-10T21:12:33Z ERROR restore-service: UnwrapEnvelope failed for keyId arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abc123 - AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789:assumed-role/restore-role-prod/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abc123
```
hannah: which principal is that? restore-role-prod was renamed last week to restore-role-main as part of housekeeping. there was a short-lived alias to preserve backward compatibility but maybe old ARNs were used in grants.
owen: I see in audit logs that CreateGrant calls were made referencing granteePrincipal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/restore-role-prod at 3129900000-3129950000. after rename, that principal no longer maps for future decrypts if the grant was tied to the old principal exact ARN.
sec_bot: audit-search: https://internal.logs/redwood/search?q=createGrant+restore-role-prod -> results show grants created on 3129951000 with GrantId g-0a1b2c.
maria: AWS KMS grants are bound to specific principals (exact ARN) — a role rename will break it. Did the rename remove the old role or just create a new one?
hannah: ops-reorg script removed the old role and created restore-role-main. it did not re-attach grants or patch resources that referenced the old ARN.
owen: impact: 18 restores failed across 5 tenants; some are in-flight customer restores. no signs of data exfiltration, just inability to decrypt.
ryan: immediate mitigation options: 1) recreate a role with the old name and attach the same ARN (painful if name reserved), 2) re-create grants for the new role (CreateGrant) scoped to affected envelope keys, 3) for customer-managed CMKs, we need tenant consent.
lucy: also check our audit logs for any automated revoke/re-issue flow triggered by role change detection; we might have inadvertently retired grants when the principal looked stale.
sec_bot: cross-check done: 12 grants reference internal CMKs we own, 6 reference customer CMKs. report: https://internal.tasks/scan/role-rename-456.
maria: execute plan: - hannah/owen: spin up temporary restore-role-prod alias (recreate a role with that name and assume-role trust to ops principals) to restore immediate decrypt capability OR call CreateGrant for the new role. Which is faster?
hannah: CreateGrant is fastest and leaves better audit trail. but we need to ensure we only grant Decrypt/GenerateDataKey and set Constraints EncryptionContextSubset to avoid scope creep. I'll start issuing grants for internal CMKs now.
owen: I'll compile a list of envelope keyIds affected and run a one-off CreateGrant script with limited lifetime (retire-on-delete) and log grant ids.
ryan: also notify support so they can update customer tickets and avoid duplicate escalations.
lucy: legal/security: for the 6 customer-managed CMKs we must ask tenants to re-grant or provide a temporary grant. don't modify customer CMKs without approval. open a legal loop now. link: https://internal.comms/legal/inc-2033
hannah: running a test CreateGrant for key abc123 -> `aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abc123 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/restore-role-main --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={snapshot=tenant-73}` -> returns GrantId g-9z8y7x at 3130000030.
sec_bot: audit: CreateGrant by hannah at 3130000030 logged.
owen: replayed 3 failed restores that used those grants -> decrypt succeeded.
maria: postmortem prep: root cause = role rename + grants bound to old principal ARN + lack of pre-deploy cross-checking for principal-bound grants. action items: - add CI check to detect renames that break KMS grants - enhance role-rename playbook to auto-recreate grants or reissue them - document requirement: never delete role ARN without coordinating security + KMS team - add an alert for sudden increase in kms:Decrypt AccessDenied errors with a runbook link.
ryan: severity set to P1 given customer impact. owners: hannah (grant reissue), owen (enumerate affected snapshots + replays), maria (postmortem + customer comms), lucy (legal engagement).
lucy: opened legal ticket and looped tenant contacts for the 6 customer CMKs.
hannah: finishing grant reissues for internal CMKs now, will post GrantIds and patch restore jobs. expect restores to recover within 15m.
ryan: thanks team. if anyone sees unexpected KMS operations outside this window tag me and @oncall. :white_check_mark:
